title: Dulmál room state diagram
description: Where a room is: in the lobby with no game, or in a game whose phase is the clue, the guessing or the end. The Durable Object keeps it; every change comes from a player's message or the timer alarm.

states.description: No game: players join, trade teams and choose clue-givers; the host sets the timer and word list.
The team on turn waits for its clue-giver's word and number.
The team on turn's guessers reveal words, up to the number plus one.
A team found all its words, or the other revealed the game-over word; everyone sees the key.

transitions.guard: each team has a clue-giver and a guesser
transitions.action: deal 25 words: 9, 8, 7 neutral and the game-over word

transitions.guard: one word not on the board; number 1 to 9

transitions.trigger: guess of the team's own word
neutral or other team's word, stop, last guess used, or timer runs out

transitions.guard: the game-over word, or a team's last word
